description: An HTML file that sets up a user interface with a menubar and various interactive widgets using the Isomorphic SmartClient library. It includes scripts for creating and manipulating GUI components such as images, canvases, menus, and layout containers.

classes.name: Img
classes.description: Represents an image widget created using the SmartClient framework.

classes.name: Canvas
classes.description: A container widget used as a drawing area.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents a menu component for user interaction.

classes.name: Menubar
classes.description: A horizontal menu bar container for menus.

methods.name: moveUp
methods.description: Moves the widget upward by 20 pixels if it is not already at the top limit.

methods.name: moveRight
methods.description: Moves the widget to the right by 20 pixels within boundary limits.

methods.name: moveDown
methods.description: Moves the widget downward by 20 pixels within boundary limits.

methods.name: moveLeft
methods.description: Moves the widget to the left by 20 pixels within boundary limits.
